description: Re-runs a public FinzData Hub strategy (slug from list_strategies) exactly as published, on its full point-in-time history through end (default today), on the server. Free on every tier, no API key needed. Returns stats, benchmark stats, equity curve, the published spec and the strategy page. To change parameters or test your own idea over full history use fork_strategy or run_backtest (free tier: last 12 months; full history with any purchase).

as_of.description: Point-in-time cutoff (YYYY-MM-DD). Nothing dated after this is returned, preventing look-ahead bias. Defaults to today (UTC).

end.description: Last date to run through (YYYY-MM-DD). Default today.

name: run_strategy
title: Re-run a listed strategy
